recommendation.recommendation: Apply immediate controlled irrigation to relieve severe water stress
recommendation.justification: Satellite NDWI indicates high water deficit (‑0.35) and the collaborative reasoning flags critical crop water stress despite excellent soil health and strong market prices. Immediate irrigation will protect yield potential and enable the farmer to capitalize on the favorable market at Tiruvarur Mandi.
actions: Start flood irrigation today, delivering enough water to bring soil moisture to field capacity (≈0.32 m³/m³).
Maintain irrigation schedule of every 7–10 days during the flowering stage, adjusting based on soil moisture readings.
Use soil moisture sensors or gravimetric sampling to verify that wilting point (0.14 m³/m³) is not approached.
Record water applied (volume per hectare) for future efficiency analysis.
recommendation.expected_outcome: Reduced water stress will preserve canopy vigor (NDVI ≥0.75), protect yield potential, and allow harvest timing that maximizes profit at the top market price of 7,618 INR/quintal.
monitoring_plan: Daily visual inspection of leaf turgor and wilting symptoms.
Measure soil moisture at 20 cm depth each day for the first week, then every 2–3 days.
Weekly satellite NDWI update to confirm stress reduction (target NDWI ≥0.10).
Track irrigation volumes and compare against crop water requirement charts.
Monitor market price trends weekly leading up to harvest.
